tasks.title: Unify the candidate and encoding contract; tiny-set fit
tasks.notes: Ran over all 48,714 states. Legal actions per state: median 39, p90 253, max 756. Stored candidates: capped at 48, so truncation fires on 22,276/48,714 states (45.73%). Teacher recall measured BEFORE any forced insertion: 75.27% under a label-independent shared selector at a 48 cap, versus 100% for the converter's stored array (which is inflated because the converter forces the teacher's action in). Per-type keep rates expose what is lost: support 0.6%, heal 11.6%, destroy_town 23.1%, move 23.2%, summon 41.3%, repair 47.3%, wait 53.5%, end_turn 54.1%. Conclusion: a label-independent selector at 48 candidates CANNOT preserve teacher behaviour on this distribution, so the honest choice is full legal candidates or an explicitly reported recall loss. NOT done: the 128-state diagnostic set, feature-collision fixtures, the Python/TS parity run and the ~99% tiny-fit check.

tasks.title: Re-measure existing models under one protocol
tasks.notes: First batch complete on SDPLAN:sd-normal:(2) Duel.aem, seeds 2026070501/2026070502, all engine-discovered seats, maxSteps 20000. src/deployed weights (sha256 1721ca17...): 2/4 natural wins, mirror 2/4, delta 0.00. budget_s42 (sha256 25361b1b...): 0/4, delta -0.50. v2_honest_s42 (sha256 60f24e60...): 0/4, delta -0.50. Zero truncations and zero fallbacks in every arm; p50 38-40 ms. Every game on this map was won by alliance 0 regardless of who the candidate was, so the discriminating power of this map is weak and the numbers are a directional reading, not a certified effect size. The key negative claim is supported: the corrected full-pool model (v2_honest_s42) is NOT worse than the old 30k-pool model (budget_s42) here - both are 0/4 against the same mirror - so the V12 budget_s42 result must not be presented as a result for v2_honest_s42. Extension candidates (v2_honest_s42_last, budget_s1337, budget_s2026, diag_grouped_s42) remain unmeasured.

tasks.title: Distribution-consistent small-scale real training (B0 baseline mandatory)
tasks.notes: B0 trained for real: 2,439 rows (1,962 train / 477 val) over 20 roots, single named teacher heuristic, fixed split manifest, separated seeds, 496 optimizer updates per run (15,696 exposures, uniqueOptimized 1962/1962). Best validation accuracy 41.30% / 42.98% / 40.67% at model seeds 42/1337/2026, with distinct weight hashes and a byte-identical repeat for seed 42, so the trainer is deterministic. THE RESULT IS NEGATIVE AND LOCATED: the validation majority class is targetActionIndex==0 at 86.79%, so 41-43% is 44 points BELOW a constant baseline, and the cause is that the teacher's action sits at stored index 0 in 96.64% of rows but at engine-legal index 0 in only 17.67% of the pool - training and inference use different candidate permutations. Evaluation on 3-player Midway under v3: candidate 0 natural wins in every arm; the mirror won 2/6 (seed 42) and 2/6 (seed 1337). Two arms hit WALL_TIMEOUT and were classified as such rather than as losses. G3 is NOT met because the held-out action metric is not valid as a policy metric. No B1/B2/B3 arm was run.
